'''4/NG''' or '''Four-Slashing''' was a [[Service droid/Legends|service]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] owned by [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] as part of his operations on [[Genon]]. A [[valet]] and [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], 4/NG was repeatedly the target of droid-hating [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Tront]].
